thread:
ana_csm: Heads-up: Cedarwell Health on renewal radar. Onboarding metrics look ok but reps reported slower replies on long conversation threads. We'd like to propose a proactive perf pilot (routing + quantized fallback) before we present renewal options. Thoughts?

vikram_infra: Which environment? any dedicated boxes or hosted? Also are there encryption/KMS constraints to keep in mind?

ana_csm: Hosted (prod-us-west). No sensitive PHI flagged in our sanitized logs but they paste long clinical notes occasionally.

jamie_runtime: Short plan outline:
- Split by request_size: default route stays on 13B baseline, requests with token_count >= 800 -> route 8% to a 6-7B quantized model (int8) as a fallback.
- Enable prefix KV cache for repeated system prompts and conversation headers.
- Staged rollout: 8% -> 25% over 36h if metrics stable.
- Auto-revert triggers: canary_p99 > baseline_p99 + 25ms OR semantic-match-score drop >= 0.03.

jamie_runtime: Example route config for ops (devs will adapt):
```json
{
  "name": "cedarwell_perf_pilot_v1",
  "split_strategy": "by_token_count",
  "rules": [
    {"condition": "token_count < 800", "weights": {"cedarwell_13b": 1.0}},
    {"condition": "token_count >= 800", "weights": {"cedarwell_7b_q": 0.08, "cedarwell_13b": 0.92}}
  ],
  "metrics": {"monitor": ["p95","p99","error_rate","semantic_match"]},
  "auto_revert": {"p99_ms_increase": 25, "semantic_delta": 0.03}
}
```

jamie_runtime: Expected outcomes: noticeable p99 reduction for long requests on canary paths, ~30-40% compute savings for routed tokens. Risk: small changes in phrasing for the 7B path; mitigated by live semantic parity checks.

mike_solutions: I'll craft a one-pager for Cedarwell: why this helps (latency + cost), safety nets (auto-revert + audit tags), and what we need from them (sample prompts + signoff). Also include suggested wording to ease renewal talks.

ana_csm: Can we get concrete cost delta? need to put numbers in the renewal email.

jamie_runtime: Ballpark: routed quantized path ~-40% GPU time per-token vs 13B; across account that translates to ~4-6% overall infra savings at 8% routing for long sessions. If we ramp to 25%, savings ~12-15%. Will provide more exact with traffic mix.

vikram_infra: Note on compliance: Cedarwell uses customer-managed keys for a couple of feature flags. Ensure canary path preserves KMS envelope semantics. Also tag all canary requests with tenant=cedarwell and pilot_id for audit trails.

jamie_runtime: Good catch. I'll ensure the canary variant keeps the same KMS flow and that route metadata includes tenant and pilot tags. Also will add an alert rule: canary_p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.12 -> immediate rollback + page #eng-runtime.

mike_solutions: ETA for slide + QA checklist: EOD today. I'll include a short integration checklist for their devs (header passthrough, length trimming behavior, idempotency keys).

ana_csm: Ops scheduling request: can we run the pilot starting Fri 08:30 PST for 36h? Customer prefers early morning.

ops-bot: Pilot request queued: requested_start=1768891800 (Fri 08:30 PST), duration_hours=36. Ops will confirm and post a start message to this channel. :spiral_calendar_pad: 

vikram_infra: Also request: add a short eval harness of ~10 canonical prompts from the customer to measure semantic_match and BLEU-like score before and during pilot. Jamie, can you wire that into the canary pipeline?

jamie_runtime: Yep — will add semantic checks and post hourly deltas to this thread during the pilot.

mike_solutions: Great. I'll loop in the customer success renewals lead and include this pilot as part of the 'performance guarantee' in the renewal convo.

ana_csm: Quick sync in 15 to align messaging? @jamie_runtime @vikram_infra @mike_solutions :thumbsup:
